assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText:
Health practitioner
Section 23(2A), Arms Act 1983. The health practitioner must be registered with the Medical Council of New Zealand, a nurse practitioner registered with the Nursing Council of New Zealand, a psychologist registered with the New ZealaZealand Psychologists Board, or a duly authorised officer under the Mental Health (Compulsory Assessment and Treatment) Act 1992.
